No whole-tree source snapshot or tested binary hashes were captured for this record. Build47 outcomes use the retained build47 logs listed per gate. Build49 evidence was executed across the Oct 2-3 Darwin boundary; individual log timestamps are retained per gate. The build49 capability inventory was produced by a temporary helper linked against the archived build49 static library and is not a behavioral parity claim. Build50 final accepted development and release core suites, I/O, export, focused Studio, client CPU adapters, CPU-filtered renderer, and examples are recorded below. Earlier failed build50 attempts remain in excluded_or_failed_runs where superseded by later accepted runs. Build51 release and focused native gates, the server-headless recipe, and a fresh finalcore51 capability inventory are appended below. Two server-headless build attempts failed from temporary disk exhaustion before a RAM-object retry completed 114/114 steps; the earlier failures remain listed. A prepared CLI run failed because CTest used an old assetc binary, then the assetc rebuild and scoped 14-test rerun passed. The prepared export and Studio suites passed after export fixes. These completed scopes remain separate from any later integrated build, and licensed executable parity remains unavailable. Build52 dev and release gates executed October 3 in Darwin are appended as separate scopes. The release52 executor inventory is a capability snapshot of the archive hash recorded with its captured HEAD d3474640 and SourceCatalogue hash; later source commits do not change that snapshot. Server build, server Composer CTest, and headless runtime are separate gates. Initial Edge Detect/Bokeh Blur fixture and Atlas/Palette runs failed or were interrupted before repairs; those records remain below. Finalized build53 release checks are appended below. Initial joined release, core, physics, and Studio failures remain in excluded_or_failed_runs; logs containing “final” in the initial-run name are not accepted results. The finalized build53 inventory was captured with archive, HEAD, catalogue, and source-scope status verified before and after the query. The finalized build53 release snapshot is tied to imagegraph archive SHA-256 12ba805e0c9509063d55c8f655c1860f8262cfc67fbf528516484f8d4a19d717, SourceCatalogue SHA-256 57898144c111b7823f56bc5b365aaa25a21e817c1aafa68f1bec23c3b1bbbe1c, and HEAD d0611f3282e4a1358e181af621234d2ba641e1f4. Archive, HEAD, catalogue hash, and compiled-source-scope status were captured before and after the query and remained unchanged. The build53 release suites passed after repair; earlier failures remain listed. Build53 dev and server gates are now included. The two failed dev disk-exhaustion attempts remain retained below; successful RAM-backed dev gates are separate.

excluded_or_failed_runs.name: build53 physics repair2 nested surface run
excluded_or_failed_runs.result: failed; superseded by final passing physics suite

The later admission repair is covered by the passing final2 physics suite.
